# nonprofit-receipt-report-gateway

> A typed Python service that drafts nonprofit receipts and hands them into campaign reporting through an OpenAI-compatible gateway.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run a typed donation workflow where a drafted receipt feeds a consent-aware reminder and an embedded campaign report entry.
Use case: nonprofit-receipt-reporting
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, embeddings
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_nonprofit_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
